name: Native capture handoff
behavior: Open the correct staged capture and retain its intended vault.
acceptance: Capture A stops while vault B is selected; the editor still proposes vault A.

name: Local media import
behavior: Import playable video/audio and PNG/JPEG/WebP with per-file feedback.
acceptance: Import a mixed batch; valid items remain when another item fails or the batch stops.

name: Reconnect originals
behavior: Reconnect by explicit/unique matches, preserving all edits.
acceptance: Ambiguous candidates are never selected automatically.

name: Multi-track video
behavior: Independent timed video layers with deterministic compositing order.
acceptance: Upper layers cover lower layers; invisible tracks are excluded from output.

name: Multi-track audio
behavior: Mix concurrent tracks with clip/track/master controls.
acceptance: Multiple audible sources occur in decoded output, not only preview.

name: Track management
behavior: Create, rename, order, lock, hide, mute, solo and delete tracks.
acceptance: A locked track refuses mutation from pointer, menus, shortcuts and batches.

name: Split
behavior: Split at playhead or clicked context time with half-open ranges.
acceptance: Duration is conserved; annotations/captions/markers map correctly.

name: Trim
behavior: Drag edges or edit numeric source bounds.
acceptance: No empty clip; source bounds and transition dependencies remain valid.

name: Delete and ripple
behavior: Choose leave-gap or close-gap behavior; ripple is track-local.
acceptance: Other tracks do not silently move; blocked grouped/transition edits explain why.

name: Move and reorder
behavior: Drag or numerically position clips; Earlier/Later swaps adjacent clips.
acceptance: Relative teaching timing follows source-linked content.

name: Multi-selection and grouping
behavior: Select multiple clips and move/duplicate as a synchronized group.
acceptance: One shared delta and all-or-nothing validation preserve relative timing.

name: Copy, cut, paste and duplicate
behavior: Create new clip identities and copy relevant attached content.
acceptance: Cloned content has no colliding IDs; Undo restores the entire operation.

name: Undo and redo
behavior: Reversible document edits with bounded history.
acceptance: Undo does not evict originals or modify immutable rendered products.

name: Timeline navigation
behavior: Seek, play, zoom, fit, snap, markers and adjustable timeline height.
acceptance: Fit shows the entire edit; Escape cancels an uncommitted drag.

name: Contextual menus
behavior: Object-specific actions with mouse, More and Shift+F10 access.
acceptance: Clicked-time commands use the clicked position; keyboard focus returns logically.

name: Clip speed
behavior: 0.25×–4× timing with pitch option when supported.
acceptance: New duration, audio and source-linked cues use the same speed mapping.

name: Video fades
behavior: Independent in/out fade durations and supported curves.
acceptance: Handle and numeric edits produce equivalent opacity envelopes.

name: Audio fades
behavior: Gain envelopes with supported fade presets/curves.
acceptance: Decoded audio ramps instead of merely changing a drawn waveform.

name: Clip transitions
behavior: Explicit same-track video dissolve or equal-power audio crossfade.
acceptance: Only the target track is shortened by the overlap; removal restores spacing.

name: Webcam recording
behavior: Explicit setup, permission, countdown, recording, review/retake and commit.
acceptance: Opening setup alone never acquires devices; closing releases active tracks.

name: Presenter picture-in-picture
behavior: Move/resize webcam as an independent clip; shapes, crop, mirror and corner presets.
acceptance: Geometry is reflected in the encoded file and portable project.

name: Synchronized screen + webcam
behavior: Native composite capture with a shared clock and independent editable layers.
acceptance: Long-run drift is measured; failures retain usable recordings and offsets.

name: Source layout and transforms
behavior: Position, size, opacity, fit/fill, crop, rotation and flips.
acceptance: Preview and output agree; callout alignment is reviewed after source orientation changes.

name: Audio detachment
behavior: Create a linked audio asset from imported video and mute its original audio.
acceptance: Dependency survives portable packaging and source reconnection.

name: Mixer and monitoring
behavior: Clip/track/master gain, mute/solo and monitoring-only mute.
acceptance: Monitoring mute never changes export audio; sample peak is not described as loudness.

name: Waveforms
behavior: Display locally derived sample peaks for editing guidance.
acceptance: Waveform generation is cancelable/bounded in native implementation.

name: Text callouts
behavior: Timed text with position, size, appearance and background.
acceptance: Only the intersecting source span is rendered.

name: Arrows
behavior: Timed arrows with draggable endpoints and numeric appearance.
acceptance: Endpoints update predictably and survive clip movement.

name: Highlights
behavior: Timed outlined/fill highlights for a region of interest.
acceptance: Size and source timing match in preview and encoded output.

name: Spotlight
behavior: Dim the surrounding region while emphasizing the target.
acceptance: Effect respects clipping and output aspect ratio.

name: Zoom and focus
behavior: Timed animated zoom into a point of interest.
acceptance: Zoom enters/exits smoothly and does not expose empty frame margins.

name: Numbered steps
behavior: Timed numbered instructional labels.
acceptance: Step text, number and timing remain editable and clip-linked.

name: Privacy covers
behavior: Opaque stationary cover with explicit limitations.
acceptance: Warn about motion/layers and uncensored originals; encoded review is required.

name: Caption authoring/import
behavior: Manual cues and SRT/plain WebVTT import with text/timing editing and splitting.
acceptance: No automatic transcription claim; overlap/density warnings are actionable.

name: Caption outputs
behavior: Burn-in choice and subtitle-file export.
acceptance: Disabled/excluded captions are surfaced before export; exported time is timeline time.

name: Chapter markers
behavior: Name and position chapters attached to footage.
acceptance: Chapters follow source edits and appear in the companion note.

name: Title and background cards
behavior: Editable intro, chapter, closing and plain-background clips.
acceptance: Cards remain editable; intro-before-all shifts every existing track together.

name: Canvas formats
behavior: Landscape, portrait, square and classic output geometry.
acceptance: Circle frames stay circular; crop/caption warnings prompt a review.

name: Color treatment
behavior: Presets and basic brightness/contrast/saturation.
acceptance: Treat source footage, not teaching labels; not professional color-managed mastering.

name: Save editable project
behavior: Save without rendering, preserving workspace and available sources.
acceptance: Portable ZIP reopens directly; lightweight JSON asks for missing originals.

name: Rendered products
behavior: Independent output files with revision/range/snapshot provenance.
acceptance: Further edits never rewrite a prior product; restore snapshot is a new edit revision.

name: Output review
behavior: Review mode, short-range rendering and actual encoded-file playback.
acceptance: Encoded frames/audio are inspected; no simulated render completion.

name: Obsidian companion note
behavior: Markdown embed, chapters and contextual metadata.
referenceStatus: Browser package functional; native publish required
acceptance: Final reserved filename is used in the note; unrelated files are never overwritten.

name: Project/session recovery
behavior: Unsaved-state explanations, close guards, retained media and render history.
acceptance: Interrupted operations cannot destroy the last committed project.

name: Before-you-share checks
behavior: Actionable missing-media, gap, audio, caption and visibility findings.
acceptance: Each finding opens a relevant action; no synthetic quality score.

name: Guided onboarding
behavior: 22 optional interactive lessons across seven chapters.
acceptance: Dismiss/resume at the same step; starting/reading lessons makes no document edit.

name: Learning center
behavior: Searchable answers, shortcuts, chapter jumps and progress/preferences.
acceptance: Missing storage is explicit; a progress file can be restored separately from projects.

name: Focused responsive shell
behavior: One preview header, contextual properties, drawers, focus view and themes.
acceptance: Overflow relocates tools without removing them or adding a second preview toolbar.

name: Keyboard and accessible controls
behavior: Non-dragging alternatives, roving toolbar, menu/dialog focus and visible states.
referenceStatus: Browser functional; Windows AT acceptance required
acceptance: Core creation journey completes by keyboard; zoom and forced-colors remain usable.

name: Local privacy and diagnostics
behavior: No content uploads; content-free diagnostic export and clear source/output distinction.
acceptance: Report omits names, paths, captions, frames and audio.
